description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Phobos Shadow Force — SHADOW MASTERS: 'When a friendly Phobos or Scout SQUAD unit has shot: Those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden.' The rule names no phase, so (07.02.01 commentary) it applies after a FIRE OVERWATCH snap shot too, and snap shooting is ranged attacks that break 13.09 HIDDEN. Regression: the card was only offered in the Shooting phase's unit_has_shot window, so an overwatching Phobos unit lost Hidden for the rest of the opponent's turn and its own next turn. Fixture sm11e_m2a_marines_active, P2's Movement phase (round 2): the Ork player turns Skip Overwatch off and ends the phase; the Space Marine player uses FIRE OVERWATCH with the Infiltrator Squad (in a ruin) at the Gretchin with real clicks; the new unit_has_shot_out_of_phase window offers SHADOW MASTERS (stay hidden / D6" move); a REAL click on 'Stay hidden' — in P2's Shooting phase the Infiltrators are hidden, but cannot go to ground (13.11.01).

steps.comment: Setup privileges: only the Infiltrator Squad (P1, PHOBOS INFANTRY — Phobos Shadow Force is taken) and Gretchin Alpha (P2) stay in play, 14" apart; a dense ruin under the Infiltrators (the fixture board's terrain is stashed and restored in cleanup); P2's turn of battle round 2 (P1 went first: turn index 5); P1 6 CP, P2 0 CP (no Ork reactions); wounds allocated automatically.
